title: Meg at the Preschool
lines: Meg helps at the preschool down the street.
She had a plan to bake a cake.
The first cake came out flat and sad.
Meg had to reread the plan two times.
The pan was too big! That was it.
She had to remake the whole cake.
The next cake got tall. Meg had a grin.

questions.ask: What went wrong with the first cake?
questions.listenFor: It came out flat. The pan was too big. Have them find the word pan.

questions.ask: What did Meg do to work out the problem?
questions.listenFor: She had to reread the plan. Point out the word reread - read it again.

questions.ask: When is it good to reread a thing? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason - you missed a bit, you forgot a step.
